desc: Derive the exact algebraic transformation of the segment-order term into a single constant plus per-cut suffix-cost contributions.
Define prefix sums and the \(O(1)\) transition cost for each possible final segment.
Implement the \(O(n^2)\) one-dimensional DP with correct initialization and final constant handling.
Validate the implementation against both examples and edge cases, including one element and splitting every element.
Ensure the required Python signature and arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic are used.
